create.name: Julie Peters
create.bio:
Julie Peters is a writer, Tarot reader and yoga and meditation teacher who lives in Edmonton, Alberta. She practised yoga and meditation for two decades and for eleven years ran Ocean and Crow, a yoga studio in Vancouver, before moving to Alberta, where she also trained and registered as a counselling therapist. She writes regularly for Spirituality & Health magazine and has a large library of guided meditations on Insight Timer.

Her teaching draws on mythology, folklore and the turning of the seasons. Her books with David & Charles retell goddess stories and mythic figures from many cultures as mirrors for ordinary life, and The Full Moon Yearbook follows the names and rituals that different traditions have given each full moon. She offers process-focused Tarot readings, online or in person in Edmonton, treating the cards as a way into reflection rather than fortune-telling, and runs small online courses on the history and symbolism of the deck. Her free recorded yoga classes, many tied to the lunar phases, are on YouTube, and her short guided meditations range from dream recall to seasonal festivals such as Samhain and Imbolc.

books.title: Maiden, Warrior, Mother, Crone: Divine Feminine Archetypes for Modern Life
books.author: Julie Peters
books.description: Fresh retellings of goddess myths and legendary women from around the world, each read as a guide to a stage or mood of a woman's life. The stories are paired with reflections on what these figures can teach about strength, loss and change.

books.title: Witch, Healer, Priestess, Outcast: Divine Feminine Archetypes for Modern Life
books.author: Julie Peters
books.description: The second book in her archetypes series, gathering lesser-known mythic women whose tales have faded from view. It draws on oral storytelling to look at the shadow and the light in these figures and what they offer readers now.

books.title: The Full Moon Yearbook
books.author: Julie Peters
books.description: A month-by-month companion to the thirteen full moons of the year, tracing the names that various cultures have given them. Each chapter pairs the folklore behind a moon with simple rituals and reflections for that time of year.

courses.title: Divine Feminine in the Tarot
courses.description: A four-week online course on the goddess myths hidden in the Major Arcana, from Asherah and Isis to Maat and Morgan le Fay. Classes are live with time for discussion and are recorded for those who cannot attend. Beginners and experienced readers are both welcome.
courses.price: $200 CAD + tax before 7 January, $250 CAD + tax after

courses.title: Process-Focused Tarot Readings
courses.description: One-to-one Tarot sessions on Zoom or in person in Edmonton, in which the cards are drawn and talked through together as a prompt for reflection. Recorded readings that you watch later are also offered at lower prices.

free_resources.title: A Guided Meditation for Dream Recall
free_resources.description: A slow morning practice for remembering last night's dreams, with a simple way to reflect on them and set an intention for the day.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation: Inviting Intuition at Samhain
free_resources.description: A short seasonal sitting for the Celtic festival that opens the dark half of the year, focusing on the third eye and inner knowing.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation: The Calming Power of Water
free_resources.description: An element meditation that uses the image of flowing water to settle irritation and let feelings move.
